sentences.text: General Manager Northern Railway vs . Raj Kumar & on 17 July,

2023 
Author: Virender Singh
Bench: Virender Singh
General Manager Northern Railway Vs. Raj Kumar & .
Others Rfa No.141 of 2018 17.07.2023

Present: Mr. Virbahadur Verma, Central Government
Counsel, for the appellant.
Mr. Ajay Sharma, Senior Advocate with Ms. Kavita Kajal, Advocate for respondents No.1(a) to 1(d).
Ms. Leena Guleria, Deputy Advocate General for respondents No.2 and 3. Cmp No. 8583 of 2023.

General Manager, Northern Railway, has assailed the award dated 31.3.2012, passed by learned Additional District Judge, (Fast Track Court), Una, in LAC Petition No.46 of 2008, in the main appeal, which was filed under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, (Fast Track Court), Una
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The said appeal was decided by this Court vide judgment dated 7.1.2023, along with a batch of appeals, lead case whereof are RFA No.104 of 2015.
During the pendency of the appeal, respondent No.1 has expired.

Now, by way of the present application, applicants, who are legal representatives of respondent No.1, have sought their impleadment, in the matter, as legal representatives of respondent No.1 Raj Kumar.

In order to substantiate their prayer, the applicants have relied upon the legal heir certificate issued by the competent authority, after the death of Raj Kumar, .
who has been impleaded, as respondent No.1, in this case.

Apart from the legal heir certificate, the applicants have also placed on record the photocopy of jamabandi for the year 2017-18, depicting therein that the mutation of the land, recorded in the name of Raj Kumar, has been sanctioned in their favour vide mutation No.1246 dated 9.9.2021.

Considering the factual position and in view of the law laid down by this Court in Collector Land Acquisition NHPC versus Khewa Ram & Others, Latest HLJ 2007 (HP), 270, the application is allowed and the applicants are ordered to be brought on record, as respondents 1(a) to 1(d).

entities.text: Collector Land Acquisition NHPC versus Khewa Ram & Others, Latest HLJ 2007 (HP), 270

sentences.text: The present application has been moved by the respondents-applicants, for release of the remaining amount of compensation, which was awarded, in favour of respondent No.1.

Since 50% of the amount has already been .
released in favour of respondent No.1, vide order dated 10.5.2018, passed in CMP No.4072 of 2018,
as well as, no objections made by learned counsel for the appellant/non- applicant, the remaining amount of compensation, along with upto date interest, is ordered to be released to the applicants, in equal share, by remitting the same to their Bank accounts, particulars whereof find mentioned in para 2 of the application.
The application stands disposed of.
(Virender Singh) Judge July 17, 2023(ps)
